interface.longDescription: Compare the same Uber Eats and DoorDash basket, final totals, applied discounts and delivery windows. Uses authorized provider tools or the host browser and checks quote consistency. Requires available provider access and sign-in; does not order or book. Includes an experimental Uber/Lyft ride workflow. Returns comparison cards on compatible MCP Apps hosts; local sorting and fee expansion do not recheck prices. Ordinary mobile chat availability is unverified.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compare Uber and Lyft for one standard ride. Ask for my pickup and destination, then check both live prices and times. Do not book.
